schema.description: Request body for the BFL FLUX.1 Kontext [pro] API. Edits input_image when one is supplied; generates from the prompt alone when it is not.

example.prompt: A watercolor painting of a lighthouse at dawn, soft light on the water

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the output between 21:9 and 9:21, e.g. 16:9. Defaults to the input image's aspect ratio when one is given, otherwise 1:1.

input_image.description: Image to edit, as a base64-encoded image or an http(s) URL. Optional; without it the model generates from the prompt alone.

input_image_2.description: Additional reference image, base64-encoded or an http(s) URL (experimental multi-reference).

input_image_3.description: Additional reference image, base64-encoded or an http(s) URL (experimental multi-reference).

input_image_4.description: Additional reference image, base64-encoded or an http(s) URL (experimental multi-reference).

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the edit to apply to input_image, or the image to generate when no input_image is given.

prompt_upsampling.description: Whether to upsample the prompt. If active, the prompt is automatically modified for more creative generation.

safety_tolerance.description: Tolerance level for input and output moderation, between 0 (most strict) and 6 (least strict).

seed.description: Optional seed for reproducibility. A random seed is used when omitted.

webhook_secret.description: Optional secret for webhook signature verification.
